svg.title: A roadmap across teams — SoftTrack web design mockup (#278)
svg.desc: The roadmap draws one team’s epics against their target dates, so somebody on three teams has three roadmaps. A roadmap outside any team shows the epics of every team the viewer is on, grouped by team, initiative or lead, with a start date on each epic, milestones and releases on the bars, and an epic past its target marked in words.
svg.text: Every epic, on one time axis

g.text: /roadmap, signed in as Lena, who is on three teams
or by team, or by lead

svg.text: A start date on an epic

g.text: Optional. Without one, the bar starts where the epic was created,

svg.text: Dragging an end changes the date

g.text: For somebody who may edit the epic. With the keyboard: focus the
bar’s end, then the arrow keys move it a day, and with Shift a week.

svg.text: Done when /roadmap shows the epics of every team the viewer is on and the initiatives they belong to, grouped by team, initiative or lead and filtered by state, lead and team; an
epic has an optional start date; the axis zooms by month, quarter and year with today marked; milestones and releases are drawn on the bars; dragging an end changes the date,
with the keyboard too; and the view lives in the URL.
